attempts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create one 16:9 live-action dark fantasy film frame, W09: 'That night, he killed every last one of the Killu household.' The SAME adult black-haired warrior stands exhausted at screen left in his SAME battered overlapping black iron armor and heavy torn dark burgundy cape. His lowered broad greatsword is held in his RIGHT gauntlet; pommel, grip, guard center and blade ridge form one rigid straight axis. Blood smears and spatter on the blade, gauntlet, breastplate and a small dark splash on his cheek. Six clearly adult dead household members in period clothing lie motionless at different depths across the hall, with anatomically believable fallen postures, one foreground body face down beside a blood-soaked sleeve, another against the stair base, others near overturned dining benches.
